title: Accounts Payable Administrator
description:
Accounts Payable Administrator

- Have good communication skills and be confident handling queries.
- Be comfortable using finance systems and Microsoft Excel.
- Enjoy working as part of a team whilst also being able to work independently.

In return, you will:
- Receive a salary of 26,000 per annum.
- Benefit from hybrid working and flexibility.
- Join a friendly and supportive finance team.
- Enjoy a good work-life balance.
- Have the opportunity to develop your skills and progress, should you wish to.

Interested?

Please apply with your CV for further information.

Applicants must have the right to work in the UK.

title: Bookkeeper

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant / Accounts Assistant

Location: Malvern, Worcestershire
Salary: 26,000 - 27,000 per annum
Hours: 25-35 hours per week
Job Type: Permanent Full-time or Part-time
Benefits: On-site gym

The Opportunity

Vibe Recruit is working on behalf of an established business in Malvern to recruit a highly organised and detail-oriented Finance Assistant / Accounts Assistant to join their team.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone with experience in accounts administration, credit control or finance who is looking to develop their skills within a supportive working environment.

Working closely with the Finance Manager, you will play an important role in supporting the day-to-day financial operations of the business, including invoicing, payment processing, account reconciliations and tenant account management.

Key Responsibilities
- Assist with accounts payable and receivable, including processing invoices, payments and expenses.
- Maintain accurate financial records and tenant accounts, investigating and resolving discrepancies.
- Support credit control and rent collection activities, contacting tenants regarding outstanding payments via telephone, email and written correspondence.
- Complete bank reconciliations and ensure financial transactions are accurately recorded.
- Assist with the preparation of financial reports and statements.
- Maintain and update financial databases using Xero and Microsoft Excel.
- Monitor outstanding balances and produce regular reports on arrears, payment status and collection progress.
- Provide day-to-day administrative support to the finance and property management teams.
- Ensure financial processes are carried out in accordance with company procedures.
- Assist with audits and other ad hoc finance-related projects.

About You

The ideal candidate will be organised, proactive and confident working with financial information, with the ability to manage competing priorities and communicate professionally with customers and colleagues.

We are looking for someone who has:
- Previous experience in an accounts, finance administration, credit control or similar role.
- Experience using accounting software such as Xero, Sage or QuickBooks.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
- Excellent attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Strong organisational and time management skills.
- Confident communication skills, particularly when dealing with payment queries and outstanding balances.
- The ability to work independently while contributing positively to a team.
- A professional, approachable manner and the ability to remain calm under pressure.

Experience in property management, tenant accounts or Workday software would be advantageous but is not essential.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of 27,000 per annum.
- Full-time or part-time opportunity, working 25-35 hours per week.
- On-site gym.
- Friendly and supportive working environment.
- Opportunities for professional development and career progression.
- Varied responsibilities across finance and property management.
- The opportunity to join an established business.

If you are an experienced Accounts Assistant, Finance Assistant or Credit Controller looking for your next opportunity in Malvern, we would love to hear from you.

Apply today with your updated CV to find out more about this opportunity.

Vibe Recruit is acting as an Employment Agency in relation to this vacancy.

title: Finance Assistant
company: West Midlands & Worcestershire Perm Hub - Agency - Permanent
description:
Finance Assistant- Maternity Cover ( until July 2027)

Salary: Circa £29,000 Pro rata
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00am - 4:30pm
Location: Redditch

We are currently recruiting for a Finance Assistant to join a busy and growing finance team based in Redditch.

This is an excellent opportunity for an organised and detail-focused finance professional looking to develop their career within a successful civil engineering and groundworks business. The role plays a critical part in ensuring the accurate processing of weekly labour payments, subcontractor costs and contract-related financial information. Based on the role profile contained in the successful candidate will support the weekly payment process for approximately 500 operatives across multiple construction projects.

As Finance Assistant, your responsibilities will include:
- Processing weekly timesheet information for approximately 500 operatives through the company's workforce management system.
- Validating attendance records, working hours, site allocations and pay rates.
- Calculating authorised overtime, weekend payments and approved payment adjustments.
- Investigating discrepancies, missing information and payment queries.
- Preparing weekly payment submissions for the company's external employment agency.
- Maintaining accurate operative records and ensuring all amendments are properly authorised.
- Posting labour costs to the ERP system and allocating costs to the correct contracts and projects.
- Reconciling payment reports and investigating any variances.
- Reviewing subcontractor invoices and ensuring charges are accurate and appropriately supported.
- Supporting month-end activities, labour cost reconciliations and continuous process improvements.

The successful Finance Assistant candidate will have:
- Previous experience within a finance, accounts or financial administration role.
- Strong numerical and analytical skills with excellent attention to detail.
- Experience working with high-volume data and reconciliations.
- Good Excel skills and confidence working with large datasets.
- The ability to work accurately to strict weekly deadlines.
- Strong organisational and communication skills.
- A methodical approach to financial processes and record keeping.

Desirable Experience
- Experience processing timesheets, payroll inputs or labour payments.
- Experience using ERP or accounting systems.
- AAT studies or a finance-related qualification.

In return the Finance Assistant role can expect to receive:-
- Competitive salary of circa £29,000
- Full-time hours of 8:00am - 4:30pm
- Opportunity to join a well-established and growing organisation
- Supportive finance team environment

If you have the experience and skills required and are looking for your next challenge within a dynamic finance team, please apply with your updated CV.

title: Payroll Assistant
company: MultiStaff Recruitment Solutions Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
As a Payroll Associate, you will support the smooth and compliant delivery of payroll services for a wide range of clients. Working closely with the Payroll Manager and wider team, you will process payrolls accurately, help with onboarding new clients, respond to client queries, and ensure deadlines are consistently met. This role is ideal for someone who is detail oriented, organised, and keen to develop within a growing payroll function.

Key Responsibilities

Payroll Processing
- Process weekly, fortnightly and monthly payrolls accurately within agreed deadlines.
- Prepare and submit RTI submissions, EPS, and pension contributions.
- Handle statutory payments (SSP, SMP, SPP), holiday pay, adjustments, and payroll corrections.
- Ensure accurate maintenance of employee records, starters, leavers, and amendments.

Client Support & Communication
- Respond to client queries promptly and professionally.
- Liaise with Client Managers where further clarification or fee discussions are required.
- Maintain high standards of accuracy, confidentiality, and client care.

Team Support & Workflow
- Assist with organising workload and supporting team members during peak times.
- Provide holiday/emergency cover where needed.
- Support the allocation of new payrolls and follow internal processes consistently.

Onboarding & Compliance
- Support onboarding of new payroll clients by gathering required information and setting up systems.
- Ensure compliance with HMRC, pension providers, and internal governance.
- Keep up to date with payroll legislation, software updates, and internal procedures.

Operational Administration
- Keep target sheets, internal trackers and payroll checklists updated (where required).

The salary is based on full time so will be pro rota.

Flexible working hours but ideally Monday - Friday around 5 hours per day.
